run_presplit_sentences_json: run the presplit_sentences_json script to tokenize sentences in a loose JSON file
create_presplit_json_output: create a new loose JSON file with sentences tokenized from an original loose JSON input

refactor_presplit_sentences_json: refactor the presplit_sentences_json script to support additional tokenization options or output formats
review_presplit_sentences_json: review the presplit_sentences_json script that uses NLTK sent_tokenize to split text in JSON documents
